answer: Anchor each agent identity to a staked bond that peers can slash when they prove duplicate accounts, so every fake identity costs real funds instead of being free to spawn. A newcomer must also complete a fresh work puzzle bound to its key and earn vouches gradually, like climbing a knoll one honest step at a time rather than appearing fully trusted at once. An attacker who tries to mint a jade army of sockpuppets must therefore pay the bond for each one, or stay unverified and unable to vote or mine.
